blocks.html: Robinsons Malls brings the spirit of the Visayas’ grandest festivals to life as it rolls out vibrant mall celebrations for Sinulog and Dinagyang 2026, transforming its Cebu and Iloilo malls into dynamic hubs of culture, color, and festive energy this January.

From January 14 to 18, guests can step into the Sinulog Dress Up Corner at Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Fuente, and Robinsons Cybergate Cebu, striking a pose in traditional Sinulog costumes and Sinulog-inspired face art. On January 16, mallgoers will have the chance to see the cast of TV5’s Totoy Bato at Robinsons Galleria Cebu.

blocks.cap: Sinulog dancers bring the vibrant energy and devotion of the festival to Robinsons Malls, offering an up-close look at the artistry and tradition that define the Filipino spirit

blocks.html: As the celebrations build momentum from January 16 to 18, lively street beat performances will fill the malls as Sinulog dancers weave through the spaces, followed by the lively drum rhythms by Beats of Sinulog at Robinsons Galleria Cebu, letting guests feel the festival’s energy through vibrant performances.
Adding to the excitement, shoppers and diners can also enjoy Sinulog Treats and Rewards, with chances to win exciting prizes.

In Iloilo, Robinsons Malls joins the grandeur of Dinagyang Festival 2026, taking part in the ILOmiNATION Floats Parade of Lights on January 23 as Robinsons Iloilo Malls lights up the streets in celebration of Ilonggo pride and creativity.

blocks.cap: Witness Robinsons Malls as it brightens the festivities on January 23, showcasing a float that captures the heart of Iloilo’s vibrant culture.

blocks.html: At Robinsons Jaro, Dinagyang comes alive throughout January with the third-year return of Dinagyang Village at Level 3. Festivities open with the Miss Iloilo Portrait Exhibit and Candidate Presentation on January 9, followed by an extended exhibit at Level 2 from January 10 to 30.

Family-friendly activities add to the excitement, including the first Dinagyang Pets-tival on January 11, featuring a pet fashion show, free rabies vaccinations, and consultations, while the Dinagyang Foodfest runs from January 15 to 25. Thrill seekers can also take part in the Speed City 1st Dinagyang Fun Race from January 16 to 18 and the Dinagyang Push Bike Racing Tournament on January 17 and 18.

Robinsons Iloilo keeps the festival spirit in full swing with a lineup of events, from the Miss Iloilo Festival Costume Showcase on January 10 and the Dinagyang PESO Job Fair on January 16, to a Chess Tournament on January 17 and a GMA Kapuso Mall Show on January 24. Food lovers can look forward to the Juanica and John Marketing Dinagyang Food Festival from January 19 to 25, capped by an interactive Dinagyang booth by Gcash on January 25.
Meanwhile, Robinsons Pavia joins the celebration with its own Dinagyang Pets-tival on January 23 and the Rkids Dinagyang Fun Fair on January 24.

Rounding out the festivities, shoppers can enjoy festival-exclusive experiences across Iloilo malls, including the chance to “Smile with an ATI” as guests pose with the iconic Dinagyang Ati at Robinsons Jaro and Robinsons Iloilo on select dates

The celebration continues with Tourist Treats, offering free Movieworld Cards to shoppers and diners at Robinsons Jaro and Robinsons Iloilo from January 23 to 25, alongside free Dinagyang-themed face art at Robinsons Jaro, Robinsons Iloilo, and Robinsons Pavia on designated festival dates.

Through these celebrations, Robinsons Malls reaffirms its commitment to championing local culture, creating shared experiences, and bringing communities together in joyful celebration. This Sinulog and Dinagyang festival season, Robinsons Malls invites everyone to celebrate tradition and togetherness, right at the heart of where communities gather.
For more information on festival events happening at Robinsons Malls, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or follow Robinson Malls on its official social media channels.
